change.summary: Create Scylla lightning only when its native terrain-floor search starts in an already loaded chunk.

before.loaded_chunk: Scylla searches down from the lightning position and creates the native lightning storm on the terrain floor.
before.missing_chunk: The first Level.getBlockState call can synchronously request an absent chunk from the server tick.

after.loaded_chunk: Run the complete native terrain-floor search and create the unchanged native lightning storm.
after.missing_chunk: Skip this lightning strike without requesting or generating the absent chunk.

modifiers.notes: The guard changes only Cataclysm 3.31 Scylla spawnLightning calls. It does not change Scylla registration, AI timing, damage, loaded-terrain strikes, loot or encounter ownership.

cause.owner: JEM World Boss Tiers Cataclysm adapter

rationale.purpose: Prevent Scylla lightning from parking the server tick in a missing-chunk wait while preserving the native attack in loaded terrain.
rationale.decision_source: The user reported inability to connect on 2026-11-23. The local watchdog crash stopped in Cataclysm 3.31 Scylla_Entity.spawnLightning at its first Level.getBlockState call while Streams Reflowing's land-wait Mixin had parked the server thread and its urgent worker queue was idle. Exact installed bytecode confirms that the method starts a downward terrain-floor search with a direct block-state read and has no loaded-chunk guard.

introduced.summary: Keep Cataclysm 3.31 Scylla lightning terrain searches inside loaded chunks.

history.summary: Skip only Scylla lightning strikes whose native floor search would begin in an absent chunk after that query caused a local watchdog crash.

relations: Loaded lightning positions keep native Cataclysm behavior
Missing chunks remain on Minecraft's normal loading path and do not enter through a boss attack
notes: The adapter is enabled only for the inspected Cataclysm 3.31 artifact.
No watchdog threshold, Streams Reflowing worker rule or Scylla combat value is changed.
unresolved: Player rejoin, a repeated Scylla lightning attack at the same terrain boundary and sustained server uptime remain in testing until runtime acceptance.
